description: SIP trade history. Retrieve available trades for a New York calendar date or a rolling window, in time order. → Returns {code, last_update, bar_type: '1T', as_of?, window_start?, series: [{time, us?, close, volume, trade_id?, trade_exchange?, tape?, trade_conditions?}]}. Point time is Unix seconds with millisecond precision; us is Unix microseconds; last_update, as_of, and window_start are Unix milliseconds. Omit window for the whole New York day. For today or tomorrow's date alias, window=3h/6h/9h/12h/15h/18h/21h/24h selects a rolling interval [window_start, as_of) that may include yesterday's trades. Historical dates ignore window. Empty results return series: [], error=data_unavailable, and message. Use filter to summarize trades or store=json with output_file to save the response.

date.description: New York calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Today and the previous six dates are supported; tomorrow's date returns today's trades until New York midnight.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

window.description: Rolling elapsed hours for today's New York date or tomorrow's date alias; may include yesterday's trades. Omit for the whole New York day. Ignored for historical dates.

name: get_sip_trades
